prompt: Add refunds. A new order state `refunded` is reachable from `paid` and from `delivered` orders. Add `Refund(id string) (orders.Order, error)` to the order service: it refunds the full order total through the payment client and moves the order to `refunded`; the customer is told by email, like for every other state change. Refunding an order in any other state must fail with orders.ErrInvalidTransition. Expose it as `POST /orders/{id}/refund` in the HTTP API (409 when the state does not allow it). Keep the existing tests passing.
